name: Fairmont Tremblant
insider_take: Nestled at the base of the legendary Tremblant ski mountain, this alpine luxury resort transforms from winter wonderland to summer adventure playground with the changing seasons.
whats_special: The Fairmont Tremblant sits directly slopeside on North America's #1 ski resort east of the Rockies, offering true ski-in/ski-out access. The hotel's European-inspired village setting features cobblestone streets and colorful facades reminiscent of old Quebec, while the resort spans four mountain faces with over 100 trails. In summer, the same peaks become a hiking and mountain biking paradise with scenic gondola rides and zip-lining adventures.
pro_tip: Book a room on the mountain-facing side for stunning sunrise views over the Laurentian Mountains, and visit during "sugar season" (March-April) when nearby maple farms offer fresh syrup tastings.
dont_miss: The pedestrian-only village at the mountain's base with its boutique shopping, outdoor terraces, and the famous Tremblant International Blues Festival in July. Take the scenic gondola to the summit (even in summer) for panoramic views of the Laurentian forest stretching to the horizon, and explore the nearby Parc national du Mont-Tremblant, Quebec's oldest provincial park established in 1894.
pros: Ski-in/ski-out access to Mont-Tremblant's world-class slopes
Charming pedestrian village setting with boutiques, restaurants, and year-round events steps from the door
Luxurious spa and indoor pool offering a premium après-ski retreat
Four-season destination with skiing, hiking, and festivals drawing guests year-round
Elegant Fairmont rooms and suites with mountain views and refined Quebec-inspired décor
cons: Remote mountain location requires a roughly 90-minute drive from Montreal
Peak ski season and holiday periods command premium pricing
Resort fees and parking charges may add to overall stay costs
